after 6 months and hundreds of hours, my Crypto Asset Valuation Framework (CAVF) whitepaper and fundamental investing dashboard are live!

check it out here:

>> https://cavf.io/

the whitepaper is an attempt to standardize crypto valuation, with a focus on tokenholders.

the dashboard applies the framework to 50 tokens, scored across eight dimensions (traction, value accrual, team, competition, market, valuation, supply, and catalysts).

every token gets a rating at four time horizons, a tokenholder economics grade, its dilution-adjusted accrual yield (DAAY), a base-case fair value against today's price, and quality and value scores, which place all 50 tokens on a matrix.

it's an amazing tool for value investors, especially as prices are low.

more on the whitepaper and the dashboard below.

recent_posts.text:
Cyber bridge exploited via stolen signing key, team burns 5.2M CYBER to restore supply –
Link
On Nov 21, an attacker breached a cloud system, took a validator signing key and forged bridge signatures from Cyber L2 to Solana. That let them mint 5.213M CYBER, worth about $1.1M, and bridge it to Ethereum, draining part of the bridge reserves. Cyber says user wallets, the token contract, Cyber L2 and LayerZero contracts weren't affected. It paused all bridge routes within two hours, blocked a second attempt, revoked the compromised keys and burned 5.213M CYBER.
The damage was limited, but the incident shows that cross-chain security is only as strong as the operational security around its signing keys.
